source.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀שִׁ֣ירוּ לַֽ֭יהוָה שִׁ֣יר חָדָ֑שׁ תְּ֝הִלָּת֗וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל חֲסִידִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah! Sing to YHWH a new song, his praise in [the] assembly of [the] faithful.

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} a new song, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} praise in the assembly of the faithful!
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; sing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} praise where the faithful gather!
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Sing a new song to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} when {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful people meet together!

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau, {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange dans l’assemblée des fidèles !
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau ; chantez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange là où les fidèles se rassemblent !
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} un chant nouveau ! Louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} quand {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles se réunissent !

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya, sifa {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} katika kusanyiko la waaminifu!
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya; imbeni sifa {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} mahali waaminifu wanapokusanyika!
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wimbo mpya! Msifuni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} waaminifu wanapokutana pamoja!

decisions.choice: Praise Yah: hallelu-yah, a call to praise the LORD
decisions.reason: The words (hallelu yah) are a command to a group, "praise Yah"; Yah is the short form of the divine name (YHWH). Psalms 146-150 each open and close with this call. Here in Psalm 149 the renderings translate it, as "Praise the LORD", rather than keep it as the borrowed word "Hallelujah".
A new song answers a new act of God (40:4; 98:1). Here it is sung by the gathered people.

decisions.choice: assembly: the people gathered for worship
decisions.reason: The word (qahal) is the whole community gathered together (22:23).

decisions.choice: the faithful: people of loyal love
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is related to chesed, loyal love: people who hold fast to the LORD in love and loyalty (4:4).

source.text: יִשְׂמַ֣ח יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל בְּעֹשָׂ֑יו בְּנֵֽי־צִ֝יּ֗וֹן יָגִ֥ילוּ בְמַלְכָּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Let Israel rejoice in its Maker; let [the] sons of Zion be glad in their King.

en.L: Let Israel rejoice in its Maker; let the sons of Zion be glad in their King.
en.B: Let Israel be glad in the one who made it; let Zion's people rejoice in their King.
en.R: Let the people of Israel be happy, because God made them. Let the people of Zion be glad, because God is their King.

fr.L: Qu’Israël se réjouisse en celui qui l’a fait ; que les {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Sion exultent en leur Roi !
fr.B: Qu’Israël se réjouisse en celui qui l’a créé ; que le peuple de Sion soit dans l’allégresse à cause de son Roi !
fr.R: Que le peuple d’Israël soit heureux, parce que Dieu l’a fait. Que le peuple de Sion se réjouisse, parce que Dieu est son Roi.

sw.L: Israeli na amfurahie Muumba wake; wana wa Sayuni na washangilie katika Mfalme wao.
sw.B: Israeli na afurahi katika yule aliyemuumba; watu wa Sayuni na washangilie Mfalme wao.
sw.R: Watu wa Israeli na wafurahi, kwa sababu Mungu aliwaumba. Watu wa Sayuni na washangilie, kwa sababu Mungu ni Mfalme wao.

decisions.choice: its Maker: a plural form for the one God
decisions.reason: The word ("its makers", 'osav) is plural in form, as with "Maker" in Job 35:10 and Isaiah 54:5, a plural that expresses greatness, like 'elohim, "God". God made Israel a people (95:6; 100:3).

decisions.choice: the sons of Zion: the people of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The "children" of a city are its people (147:13).

decisions.choice: because God made them; because God is their King
alternatives: in its Maker; in their King
decisions.reason: Readable says why they rejoice and names God.

decisions.choice: "enfants" by default, "fils" as the gender alternative, for "the sons of Zion" at Literal
decisions.reason: The sons of Zion are the people of Jerusalem, men and women, as the meaning decision says. French follows the form it uses for "the sons of Israel" (148:14).

source.text: יְהַֽלְל֣וּ שְׁמ֣וֹ בְמָח֑וֹל בְּתֹ֥ף וְ֝כִנּ֗וֹר יְזַמְּרוּ־לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them praise his name with dancing; with tambourine and lyre let them make music to him.

en.L: Let them praise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name with dancing; with tambourine and lyre let them make music to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Let them praise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name in dance and make music for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on tambourine and lyre.
en.R: Let them dance as they praise {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. Let them play music for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} on tambourines and lyres.

fr.L: Qu’ils louent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom avec des danses ; avec tambourin et lyre, qu’ils jouent pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} !
fr.B: Qu’ils louent {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom en dansant et qu’ils jouent pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} du tambourin et de la lyre !
fr.R: Qu’ils dansent en louant {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ! Qu’ils jouent pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} du tambourin et de la lyre !

sw.L: Na walisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa kucheza; kwa matari na kinubi na wampigie muziki.
sw.B: Na walisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} kwa kucheza na kumpigia muziki kwa matari na kinubi.
sw.R: Na wacheze wanapolisifu jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Na wampigie muziki kwa matari na vinubi.

decisions.choice: dancing and the tambourine
decisions.reason: The tambourine (tof) was a hand drum, played with dancing at times of victory and joy, as when Miriam led the women after the crossing of the sea (Exodus 15:20).

decisions.choice: lyre: a small stringed instrument
decisions.reason: As in 147:7.

source.text: כִּֽי־רוֹצֶ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ יְפָאֵ֥ר עֲ֝נָוִ֗ים בִּישׁוּעָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For taking pleasure [is] YHWH in his people; he adorns [the] humble with salvation.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} takes pleasure in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} adorns the humble with salvation.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is pleased with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} dresses the humble in the beauty of salvation.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is happy with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. He honors humble people by saving them.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prend plaisir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} pare les humbles du salut.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} trouve {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} plaisir en {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} revêt les humbles de la beauté du salut.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est heureux de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Il honore les gens humbles en les sauvant.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hupendezwa na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; huwapamba wanyenyekevu kwa wokovu.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapendezwa na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; huwavika wanyenyekevu uzuri wa wokovu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anafurahia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Huwaheshimu watu wanyenyekevu kwa kuwaokoa.

decisions.choice: adorns: makes beautiful, gives honor
decisions.reason: The verb (pe'er) is to beautify or glorify (Isaiah 55:5; 60:9). God's rescue is the honor he puts on the lowly.

decisions.choice: salvation: rescue, victory
decisions.reason: The word (yeshu'ah) is rescue from danger, and so victory over enemies, which verses 6-9 go on to describe.

decisions.choice: the humble: the lowly who depend on God
decisions.reason: As in 147:6.

decisions.choice: honors humble people by saving them
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of adorning means (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Let [the] faithful exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their beds.

en.L: Let the faithful exult in glory; let them shout for joy on their beds.
en.B: Let the faithful be jubilant in their glory; let them cry out with joy as they lie on their beds.
en.R: Let God's faithful people celebrate the honor {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gives them. Let them sing happily even as they lie in bed.

fr.L: Que les fidèles exultent dans la gloire ; qu’ils crient de joie sur leurs couches !
fr.B: Que les fidèles soient dans l’allégresse de leur gloire ; qu’ils poussent des cris de joie, couchés sur leur lit !
fr.R: Que les fidèles de Dieu fêtent l’honneur qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur donne ! Qu’ils chantent de joie même quand ils sont couchés dans leur lit !

sw.L: Waaminifu na washangilie katika utukufu; na wapige kelele za furaha vitandani mwao.
sw.B: Waaminifu na wafurahi sana katika utukufu wao; na walie kwa furaha wanapolala vitandani mwao.
sw.R: Watu waaminifu wa Mungu na washerehekee heshima anayowapa. Na waimbe kwa furaha hata wanapolala vitandani.

decisions.choice: in glory: in the honor God has given them
decisions.reason: The word (kavod) is glory or honor; here it is the honor of verse 4, rescue given by God, and the honor of verse 9.

decisions.choice: on their beds: even at rest, at night
decisions.reason: The bed is where one lies down at night and is alone with one's thoughts (4:5; 63:7). Their joy goes on in private as well as in the assembly (verse 1).

decisions.choice: the honor he gives them
decisions.reason: Readable says whose honor it is (m1).

source.text: רוֹמְמ֣וֹת אֵ֭ל בִּגְרוֹנָ֑ם וְחֶ֖רֶב פִּֽיפִיּ֣וֹת בְּיָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: High praises of God [are] in their throat, and a sword of two edges in their hand,

en.L: [Let the] high praises of God [be] in their throat, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
en.B: with songs that lift God high in their throats and a two-edged sword held in their hands,
en.R: They should shout God's praises while they hold a sharp sword in their hands.

fr.L: [Que les] louanges de Dieu [soient] dans leur gorge, et une épée à deux tranchants dans leur main,
fr.B: avec des chants qui élèvent Dieu dans leur gorge et une épée à deux tranchants dans leurs mains,
fr.R: Qu’ils crient les louanges de Dieu en tenant à la main une épée bien tranchante.

sw.L: Sifa kuu za Mungu [ziwe] kooni mwao, na upanga wenye makali kuwili mkononi mwao,
sw.B: wakiwa na nyimbo za kumtukuza Mungu kooni mwao na upanga wenye makali kuwili mikononi mwao,
sw.R: Na wapaze sauti kumsifu Mungu huku wameshika upanga mkali mikononi mwao.

decisions.choice: high praises: praises that lift God high
decisions.reason: The word (romemot) is from the verb "exalt" (145:1): praise that lifts God up.

decisions.choice: a sword of two edges
decisions.reason: A sword sharpened on both sides (Judges 3:16) was a weapon for close combat. The praising people are pictured as an army ready for battle.

decisions.choice: praise and the sword: God's judgment through his people
decisions.reason: Verses 6-9 picture God's faithful people, armed and praising, carrying out his judgment on nations and kings who oppose him, as Israel's wars are described in Joshua and Judges. Elsewhere Scripture keeps vengeance as God's own (Deuteronomy 32:35, 41-43) and looks for the day when nations will no longer train for war (Isaiah 2:4). The New Testament speaks of the word of God as a sword (Ephesians 6:17; Hebrews 4:12) and tells believers to leave vengeance to God (Romans 12:19). The renderings do not soften the psalm's words.

decisions.choice: a sharp sword
decisions.reason: Readable gives the point of the picture: a sword sharp on both edges.

records.literal_gloss: to execute vengeance on the nations, punishments on the peoples,

en.L: to execute vengeance on the nations, punishments on the peoples,
en.B: to bring retribution on the nations and to punish the peoples,
en.R: They will punish the nations and pay them back for the wrong they have done.

fr.L: pour exercer la vengeance sur les nations, des châtiments sur les peuples,
fr.B: pour faire payer les nations et châtier les peuples,
fr.R: Ils puniront les nations et leur feront payer le mal qu’elles ont fait.

sw.L: ili kutekeleza kisasi juu ya mataifa, adhabu juu ya watu,
sw.B: ili kuyalipiza mataifa na kuwaadhibu watu wa mataifa,
sw.R: Watayaadhibu mataifa na kuyalipa kwa mabaya waliyotenda.

decisions.choice: vengeance: just retribution
decisions.reason: The word (neqamah) is the repayment of wrong, here as God's just sentence on nations that have done evil (Deuteronomy 32:41-43), not personal spite.

decisions.choice: punishments: rebukes, chastisements
decisions.reason: The word (tokhechot) is correction or punishment that answers wrongdoing.

decisions.choice: for the wrong they have done
decisions.reason: Readable says what vengeance answers (m1).

source.text: לֶאְסֹ֣ר מַלְכֵיהֶ֣ם בְּזִקִּ֑ים וְ֝נִכְבְּדֵיהֶ֗ם בְּכַבְלֵ֥י בַרְזֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: to bind their kings with chains, and their honored [ones] with shackles of iron,

en.L: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron,
en.B: to put their kings in chains and their nobles in iron shackles,
en.R: They will put the kings of the nations in chains and their leaders in iron shackles.

fr.L: pour lier leurs rois avec des chaînes, et leurs nobles avec des entraves de fer,
fr.B: pour mettre leurs rois aux chaînes et leurs nobles dans des fers,
fr.R: Ils mettront les rois des nations aux chaînes et leurs chefs dans des fers.

sw.L: ili kuwafunga wafalme wao kwa minyororo, na wakuu wao kwa pingu za chuma,
sw.B: ili kuwatia wafalme wao minyororo na wakuu wao pingu za chuma,
sw.R: Watawafunga wafalme wa mataifa kwa minyororo na viongozi wao kwa pingu za chuma.

decisions.choice: their honored ones: their nobles
decisions.reason: The word (nikhbadim) is people of rank and honor.

decisions.choice: chained kings: defeat in war
decisions.reason: Kings captured in war were led away in chains (2 Kings 25:7; Isaiah 45:14). The rulers who were called to praise in 148:11 are here those who refused.

source.text: לַעֲשׂ֤וֹת בָּהֶ֨ם׀מִשְׁפָּ֬ט כָּת֗וּב הָדָ֣ר ה֭וּא לְכָל־חֲסִידָ֗יו הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: to execute on them [the] judgment written. It [is] honor for all his faithful [ones]. Praise Yah!

en.L: to execute on them the judgment written; this [is] honor for all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful [ones]. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: to carry out on them the judgment already written. This honor belongs to all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: They will carry out the judgment God has written down against them. This is an honor for all of God's faithful people. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: pour exécuter sur eux le jugement écrit ; c’[est] un honneur pour tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: pour accomplir sur eux le jugement déjà écrit. Cet honneur revient à tous {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Ils exécuteront le jugement que Dieu a écrit contre eux. C’est un honneur pour tous les fidèles de Dieu. Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: ili kutekeleza juu yao hukumu iliyoandikwa; hii [ni] heshima kwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.B: ili kutimiza juu yao hukumu iliyokwisha kuandikwa. Heshima hii ni ya waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} wote. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Watatekeleza hukumu ambayo Mungu ameiandika dhidi yao. Hii ni heshima kwa watu wote waaminifu wa Mungu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

decisions.choice: the judgment written: the sentence God has decreed
decisions.reason: "Written" may mean decreed by God, as if written in his book (Isaiah 65:6), or written in Scripture, in God's warnings against the nations (Deuteronomy 32:41-43).

decisions.choice: it is honor: this task is an honor
alternatives: he is the honor of all his faithful
decisions.reason: "It" most likely is the carrying out of God's judgment just described. It could also be read as "he (God) is the glory of all his faithful".

decisions.choice: the faithful: people of loyal love
decisions.reason: The word (chasidim) is related to chesed, loyal love: people who hold fast to the LORD in love and loyalty (4:4).

decisions.choice: God has written down; God's faithful people
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the one who decreed the judgment and whose people they are (m1).
